mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_item (category_id, name, subtitle, cover_url, shelf_status, stock_mode, stock_qty, workflow_type, reviewer_ids, second_reviewer_ids) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{subtitle}, #{coverUrl}, #{shelfStatus}, #{stockMode}, #{stockQty}, #{workflowType}, #{reviewerIds}, #{secondReviewerIds})
mapper.update: UPDATE material_item SET deleted = 1, deleted_time = NOW(), deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, purge_after_time = #{purgeAfterTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE material_item SET deleted = 0, deleted_time = NULL, deleted_by = NULL, purge_after_time = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM material_item WHERE deleted = 1 ORDER BY deleted_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM material_item WHERE deleted = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE material_item SET stock_qty = stock_qty + #{qty}, last_inbound_at = IF(#{qty} > 0, NOW(), last_inbound_at) WHERE id = #{id}
